conditional_inputs.semantics: Reuse the currently declared execplan unless an exact source is explicitly confirmed.
Require the exact existing owner to relink.
Require the exact declared replacement owner.
Do not require a replacement owner.
Do not mutate until an exact owner is chosen.

guards: --apply-safe-prune must only mutate targets already present in cleanup_targets with safe_to_prune=true.
--apply requires the exact proposal id and expected Planning revision returned by preview.
Target-authority previews preserve unrelated owners, relations, worktree-local selection, and human-authored intent while refreshing only CAS-stale proposals whose semantic subjects remain current.
Target-authority apply fails closed for same-owner or semantic conflicts; disjoint eligible proposals remain independently applicable.
--apply-issue-relation-reconcile requires the current relation revision for semantic edits.
--apply-issue-relation-migration preserves membership, priority, dependencies, rationale, and maturity before demoting duplicate legacy fields.

--apply-pending-integrations applies the eligible disjoint owner set atomically on an admitted target branch, preserves stale unrelated proposals as explicit skips, and fails closed for same-owner overlap.
Fresh external completion may refresh an obsolete owner action to the exact semantic proof/intent blocker, but cannot itself satisfy proof, intent, or closeout authority.
--apply-lane-current-slice-reconcile must guard the exact owner surface, relation identity, subject, lane revision, transition, and execplan source, and must not fabricate a missing execplan.

proof: safe-prune tests cover exact roadmap/decomposition cleanup and dry-run behavior
proposal/apply tests cover revision guards, idempotence, and transaction rollback
issue-relation tests cover supported conflict repair and legacy authority migration
pending integration tests cover one-invocation target apply, stale disjoint skips, same-owner failure, and transaction rollback
target-authority reconciliation tests cover bounded preview, exact regeneration after CAS drift, semantic conflict isolation, atomic publication, preserved owner-scoped state, and idempotent replay
provider-neutral external-observation tests cover stale action refresh plus ambiguous-completion non-authority
workspace CLI tests cover missing-source block and exact source restore through the root planning reconcile front door

summary: Report planning reconciliation state and compile stale target-authority proposals into one exact preview/apply transaction.

writes.when: a preview records a reusable proposal or apply records its idempotence receipt
--apply-issue-relation-reconcile updates one semantic relation or --apply-issue-relation-migration migrates legacy strategic fields
--apply-issue-relation-migration demotes duplicate legacy strategic authority to derived references
a fresh admitted completed external observation makes the selected owner's observation-dependent next action obsolete; only the exact proof/intent blocker is refreshed

--apply-pending-integrations or --apply of a target-authority preview applies eligible pending proposals as one target transaction; the owner records, refreshed proposals, integration receipts, and reconciliation receipt publish atomically
--apply-lane-current-slice-reconcile restores an exact existing execplan onto the named lane relation
